mentions.name: vif
mentions.description: An experimental alternative to PHP's Composer package manager, built from scratch and almost ready for alpha. It aims to avoid Composer's slow dependency updates, which on some projects took 2-3 minutes only to fail at the end, since Composer's large codebase made reworking it unappealing.
mentions.problem: Composer could take 2-3 minutes to update dependencies on some projects and then fail at the end, and Composer's large PHP codebase made modifying it undesirable.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on m experimentall alternative to PHP's composer. Some projects took 2-3 mins to update with composer, only to fail at the end. Wanted to rework this, but the composer code is big and I honestly didn't feel like touching more PHP than I had to.

So I built my own package manager that's almost ready for alpha.

https://github.com/van-sprundel/vif
